name: MBL Infrastructure Limited
about: MBL Infrastructure Limited engages in the execution of civil engineering infrastructure projects in India. The company operates through three segments: Roads and Highways; Building, Housing and Urban; and Railways, Metro, and Other. It undertakes roads and highways infrastructure, building, housing and urban infrastructure, railways and metro, BOT, and other infrastructure projects. Its roads and highways offerings include engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects, build-operate-transfer (BOT) projects, and operations and maintenance (O&M) services. The company undertakes industrial construction, residential construction, and urban infrastructure development under its building, housing, and urban infrastructure vertical. It also constructs railway over bridges (ROBs), railway under bridges (RUBs), metro rail depots, and associated civil works for rail infrastructure. Additionally, MBL Infrastructure Limited engages in quarrying operations, concrete production, bitumen supply, construction material supply, and tolling operations. The company also executes civil structures, irrigation infrastructure, port infrastructure, and inland waterway infrastructure projects. The company serves clients across various Indian states, including Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Delhi, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Odisha, Assam, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh. The company was formerly known as Maheshwari Brothers Limited and changed its name to MBL Infrastructure Limited in July 2006. MBL Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in New Delhi, India.
